method: Candidates are every contract an artist address called, received NFTs from, or created. Transaction and transfer lists come from Etherscan v2 (Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum), Blockscout PRO (Optimism, Gnosis), Base Blockscout, and full-range eth_getLogs on rpc.zora.energy, mainnet.optimism.io and rpc.gnosischain.com. thirdweb proxies are read from ProxyDeployed events in factory deployProxy receipts; Zora 1155 contracts from SetupNewContract. A candidate counts as the artist's when an artist address created it (directly or through a factory), is owner(), or holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE; whyArtist lists which. name/symbol/owner/totalSupply/contractURI are eth_call reads at the latest block. tokenCount is totalSupply() for ERC-721 where present, else mint events; ERC-1155 counts distinct token ids minted. contractURIResolved is the JSON fetched through the gateway named. Royalty wallet: no contracts.
